Heroes
======

In Dungeon Defenders 2, the characters you play as are called heroes. Most heroes have 4 [Abilities](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Ability "Ability")
 and 4 [Defenses](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defense "Defense")
. The [Gunwitch](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gunwitch "Gunwitch")
, [Barbarian](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
, and [Frostweaver](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Frostweaver "Frostweaver")
 have 8 abilities and no defenses. The [Mystic](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
 and [Dryad](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dryad "Dryad")
 have 3 abilities and 5 defenses
